capabilities.description: Controlled register of all project documents, with the uploaded contract (document:harbourline_contract.pdf) and BOQ (document:harbourline_boq.xlsx) registered as the source of record, versioned, hash-sealed, and distributed with read receipts.
Holds the priced BOQ from document:harbourline_boq.xlsx as the measurement and valuation baseline: item quantities, units, rates, and amounts, from which progress claims are valued.

Prepares and certifies interim payment certificates: measures work against BOQ items, applies 5% retention per Clause 14.3, tracks release at Taking-Over and end of Defects Notification Period, and routes for approval.
Tracks time for completion (730 days, Clause 8.2) and accrues delay damages at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day, capped at 10% (Clause 8.7), with notices, evidence, and an audit trail.

Records inspection and test plans (ITPs) mapped to BOQ work items, captures inspection results and sign-offs, links non-conformances to corrective actions, and attaches evidence to the relevant claim.

Maintains the contract particulars from document:harbourline_contract.pdf (Accepted Contract Amount, time for completion, retention, performance security at 10% per Clause 4.2) and runs the approval and notice workflows that govern them.

summary: A contracts-administration platform for the Harbourline Civil Works project that makes the uploaded contract (document:harbourline_contract.pdf) and BOQ (document:harbourline_boq.xlsx) the single source of record. It supports progress claims and certificates against the priced BOQ, delay-damages accrual per Clause 8.2/8.7, QA/ITP records tied to work items, and a controlled document register, so the project team, contract administrator, and QS administer the contract consistently and auditably.
